local_rmax.description: kinetic analytes: free Rmax per cycle instead of activity-scaled Rmax
edits: (least_squares(resid, [lka, np.log10(kd0), 1.5 * rmax0], bounds=([2, -6, 0], [9, 1, 20 * rmax0])) for lka in (4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0)),

(least_squares(resid, [lka, np.log10(kd0), 1.5 * rmax0] + [1.5 * rmax0 * a for _, a, _ in series], bounds=([2, -6, 0] + [0] * len(series), [9, 1, 20 * rmax0] + [20 * rmax0] * len(series))) for lka in (4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0)),

interpolated_activity.description: activity by linear interpolation between neighbouring controls within each regeneration segment

no_activity_correction.description: assume constant surface capacity over the run

smooth_decay_only.description: model activity decay but ignore the logged harsh regeneration step (fails on most but not all seeds, depending on how many cycles fall between the harsh regeneration and the next control)
